# BizGrants Consulting

> Singapore workforce transformation and grant advisory for SME and corporate employers, covering the Career Conversion Programme (CCP), WDG(JR+) job redesign funding, and SkillsFuture schemes, managed end to end. Founded 2023. Legal name BizGrants Consulting Pte. Ltd. Office at 60 Paya Lebar Road, #06-28, Paya Lebar Square, Singapore 409051.

## Glossary

- **CCP**, Career Conversion Programme: Skills and Workforce Development Agency funding that supports employers to hire or reskill mid-career workers (Singapore Citizens and PRs) into new or redesigned roles, with structured on-the-job training (OJT).
- **SWDA**, Skills and Workforce Development Agency (formerly Workforce Singapore): the statutory board administering CCP, Job Redesign Grants, and related employment-support schemes.
- **JRG**, Job Redesign Grant: funding to redesign existing roles for productivity, transformation, or technology adoption.
- **SkillsFuture**, Singapore's national upskilling movement; SkillsFuture-supported funding underpins many CCPs and reskilling initiatives.
- **OJT**, On-the-Job Training: structured, supervised training delivered as part of an employee's day-to-day work, central to every CCP application.
- **WDG(JR+)**, SkillsFuture Workforce Development Grant (Job Redesign+): a Skills and Workforce Development Agency grant under the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package (EWTP) that funds job-redesign consultancy, manager-capability building, and HR technology (funds the job). It complements CCP (which funds the person's salary while reskilling).
- **EWTP**, Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package: the national package under which WDG(JR+) sits.

- [Pathways](https://bizgrants.consulting/pathways/): The 12 CCP pathways in Singapore with eligibility, salary minimums, and supported job families. The pathways are: (1) Different job scope, (2) ESG / sustainability, (3) Overseas markets, (4) Human resource functions, (5) Digital advertising and marketing, (6) Biomedical manufacturing, (7) Wholesale trade professionals, (8) Built environment professionals, (9) Infocomm professionals, (10) Retail professionals, (11) MICE professionals, (12) Advanced manufacturing (automation, robotics, IoT and manufacturing engineering roles).
